Working capital cycle expected to remain stable at around 120 net working capital days.
Execution of the ₹185 Cr data center LOI is expected over a 15-month timeframe.

timeline.summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes commenced commercial production of 4,200 MTPA seamless pipes, 6,000 MTPA mother hollow pipes, and fittings on 26 May 2026.
Arun Axaykumar Kothari, Promoter, declared no encumbrances by promoters or promoter group on Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited’s shares for FY2026.
Venus Pipes reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹302.2 Cr and secured a ₹185 Cr LOI for pipe spooling in data centres.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹302.19 Cr (+17.1% YoY), net profit ₹25.5 Cr (+7.6% YoY).
Venus Pipes guided for >20% revenue growth in FY27 and announced a ₹70 Cr spooling capex for data center solutions.
2026-10-20: Venus Pipes & Tubes commenced commercial production of pipe spooling manufacturing.
Venus Pipes commenced commercial production of pipe spooling operations ahead of schedule on 20 October 2026.
Venus Pipes approved preferential allotment of 22.28 lakh equity shares at ₹1,670/share, raising ₹372 Cr.
Venus Pipes received a ₹29 Cr firm order from a data centre customer as part of its ₹185 Cr LOI.
Venus Pipes secured a ₹29 Cr firm order from a data centre customer against its ₹185 Cr pipe spooling LOI.
